_comment: Bundled add-on catalog. For each entry, place <zip> and <thumbnail> in this folder. 'folder' is the AddOns subfolder the zip installs (used to detect 'already installed') — fix it if a zip uses a different name. Delete entries you don't want to ship.

addons.name: Deadly Boss Mods (DBM)
addons.description: Boss-fight warnings, timers and alerts for dungeons and raids.

addons.name: WeakAuras
addons.description: Powerful, customizable visual alerts for buffs, cooldowns and more.

addons.name: Bagnon
addons.description: Combines all your bags into one tidy, searchable window.

addons.name: Details! Damage Meter
addons.description: Detailed damage, healing and threat meters.

addons.name: OmniCC
addons.description: Adds countdown text to anything with a cooldown.

addons.name: Recount
addons.description: Classic, lightweight damage and healing meter.

addons.name: AtlasLoot Enhanced
addons.description: Browse boss loot tables from anywhere.

addons.name: Gatherer
addons.description: Tracks herb, ore and treasure locations on your map.

addons.name: TellMeWhen
addons.description: Icon alerts for cooldowns, buffs and procs.

addons.name: Skada Damage Meter
addons.description: Modular, low-memory damage and healing meter.

addons.name: NPCScan
addons.description: NPCScan helps you find NPCs by scanning nameplates.

addons.name: Postal
addons.description: Mailbox quality-of-life: open all, mass mail, and more.
